basic_info.description: South Beach luxury living awaits in this high-floor 1BD/1BA featuring designer interiors, private outdoor space, glorious natural light, panoramic views, and the most desirable floor plan at The Harrison, an amenity-rich tower just feet from The Embarcadero waterfront. Inside the 830SF showplace, tall ceilings with designer lighting rise above premium finishes, diagonal-planked oak floors, and floor-to-ceiling windows framing vistas that stretch from the Bay Bridge to Sutro Tower. A gracious foyer sweeps past a gourmet open kitchen with Bertazzoni, Bosch and Sub-Zero appliances to a stunning corner living/dining room with dramatic outlooks and a large balcony. Awake to water views in the king-size bedroom featuring walk-in and shoe closets, plus an en suite spa bathroom that opens to the living area. Central HVAC, additional closet space, storage, and a Bosch washer-dryer add comfort and convenience to this turnkey sanctuary. The Harrison offers a 24/7 attended lobby, concierge, valet parking, fitness center, outdoor pool/spa, storage locker, wine storage, and penthouse owners lounge with catering kitchen. Exceptional location close to Financial District and Mission Bay attractions and outstanding transportation options, including BART, Caltrain, MUNI, shuttles and freeways.
